data.name: Suresh
data.gender_notes: Suresh is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit sura, 'god', + īśa, 'lord' — 'lord of the gods'. Its root is Sanskrit sura + īśa. An epithet of Indra. Suresh is a Sanskrit name meaning “Lord of the gods; Indra”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Suresh expresses “Lord of the gods; Indra”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit sura, 'god', + īśa, 'lord' — 'lord of the gods'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Suresh total 27, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
